limitations: Weight hashes are recorded by B, not independently rehashed from local weight files; weights and activations were not returned.
Aggregations/checks reproduced locally; GPU inference and CKA were not independently rerun.
CKA: fixed 256 balanced examples/domain, five selected models per budget/method, exploratory.
Costs: fixed-shape pretrained short probes, M4 stage-2 proxy; not trained-model deployment timing or full training cost.
No new accuracy experiment or LoRA training in this return.

fallacy_scan.aggregation: Retain per-domain and per-seed results; OOD equal mean of Yelp/Amazon.
fallacy_scan.ecological: No claims about individual examples from method means.
fallacy_scan.selection: Only source-validation-selected models; conditional conclusions, not all hyperparameters.
fallacy_scan.base_rates: Each domain 128 positive/128 negative; not deployment prevalence.
fallacy_scan.regression_to_mean: No selection of worst seed for improvement claims.
fallacy_scan.survivorship: All 18 formal jobs and 27 probes present.
fallacy_scan.multiplicity: Descriptive CKA, no new significance search; all budgets/pools retained.
fallacy_scan.forking_paths: v2 defined before returned measurements but after seeing original accuracy; exploratory.
fallacy_scan.causality: CKA association does not prove semantic preservation causes accuracy.
fallacy_scan.reverse_causality: No causal direction inferred from CKA/accuracy.
